purpose: Follow up after idea 2 passed the matched development scorecard; compare both saved candidates on different public rule families and fresh seeds.
comparison: Mean paired accuracy difference over 30 shared seeds for each family, final B probe, and first 100 predictions after both switches.

bootstrap.interval: descriptive percentile 95%, paired by seed, no multiplicity adjustment

interpretation: Selected after inspecting development results. Evaluation rules and code are public, so this is not a blind holdout. Non-inferiority is not novelty or statistical proof; timing is diagnostic.
